hypotheses.reasoning: A long-running template-svc-reconciler transaction (93036, active 82s) holds a row lock on notifications. Because of it, UPDATEs from template-svc hit lock wait timeouts and statement timeouts. notification-svc calls to template-svc then time out after 15s, its 50-connection pool to template-svc fills up, and api-gateway returns 504s. The metrics-agent exporter drops and the TLS cert expiry warning have nothing to do with this. billing-reconciler only logged INFO lines and is not the lock holder.
The template-svc connection pool is saturated, but that is a symptom of the calls hanging, not the cause.

verdict.recommendedAction: Find and kill notif-db transaction 93036, held by template-svc-reconciler. Then fix the reconciler so it commits in short batches and sets a transaction timeout. Watch the notification-svc pool to template-svc until it drains.
